Name: I Live in This Place
Description: Submit a band or artist that comes from the town where you currently live. If your locale is too small or uncool to have produced a band, the next major urban conurbation will do. Please name the town in the comments.

Description: A song whose title is a person’s first name, no second name, no other words.

Description: A song by an artist or a band including an artist that is the son/daughter of another recognised artist.

Name: Aspirin
Description: Very slow songs.  This is not a race (an anti-race).  Prizes should not be given to the *slowest* songs,  Just the best songs that happen to be really slow. However, you may choose to downvote a song you consider too fast.
